items.title: US denies Iranian claims it hit civilian infrastructure in latest strikes
items.description: The US military says its attacks were intended to "further degrade Iranian military capabilities".

items.title: Many Ukrainian soldiers outraged over removal of defence minister, troops tell BBC
items.description: Protests erupted in Ukraine on Thursday after Mykhailo Fedorov's removal - and now soldiers are also criticising the move.

items.title: Trump threatens to tariff Canada over wildfire smoke choking northern US cities
items.description: Canadian leader Mark Carney says both the US and Canada have an equal responsibility to fight climate change, which experts say are worsening wildfire conditions.

items.title: One anti-war critic fined, another held as Russia clamps down on opponents
items.description: While Boris Nadezhdin is barred from running for parliament, blogger Ilya Remeslo is remanded in custody.

items.title: EU proposes slowing down cuts to carbon emissions for businesses
items.description: Under the proposals, the EU plans to relax its emissions trading system to give companies more time to reduce their carbon output.

items.title: Magnitude 7.3 earthquake quake strikes off Mexico coast
items.description: The US Tsunami Warning Center has recorded waves 0.3m (1.1 feet) high in Puerto Madero and Chiapas in Mexico after the quake.

items.title: Air conditioner sparked deadly blaze at children's orphanage - police
items.description: Eleven people, including children, died in the fire that also injured 19 others.

items.title: Second tanker in three months hijacked off Yemen by suspected Somali pirates
items.description: There have also been several unsuccessful attacks in a region where piracy appears to be making a comeback.

items.title: China hits out at British Steel nationalisation
items.description: The UK government said taking the firm into public hands would safeguard "a vital national capability".

items.title: Trump alleges China meddled in 2020 election and questions voting security ahead of midterms
items.description: China said Trump's claims were fabricated and US Democrats said he was paving the way to undermine November's elections.

items.title: Uganda suspends school trips after 20 pupils die in bus crash
items.description: Thousands are killed on Uganda's roads each year but this is one of its deadliest accidents involving children.

items.title: Trump Media to sell instant access to 'market-moving' social posts
items.description: Trump Media is launching a fast, paid feed to its most influential posts for Wall Street traders.
